hotspots.name: Reception
hotspots.text: Committee staff triage everything here — every bill with a dollar figure in the House crosses this desk on its way to the chair.

hotspots.name: Committee Staff
hotspots.text: Analysts who read every fiscal note. The binders hold the executive budget request, line by line.

hotspots.name: The Chair
hotspots.text: Beyond the koa doors: the member who decides which revenue bills get a hearing at all.

hotspots.name: Chair Kawaguchi
hotspots.text: A clean desk, two lamps, and the quiet power of the schedule. Bills die politely here — by never being heard.
